grants.note: An AI agent may propose, amend, check and report evidence anywhere in HashRelay, through a Host delegation the owner mints. It may never accept, reject, revoke or supersede.

policy.note: Who may decide what about HashRelay, ENFORCED BY THE HOST (Vision V3 Stage 9; ADR-0010 in continuum-architecture). This document travels once, as the body of the space's genesis act; after that the policy IS the record's `governed` lines, and changing it is itself a `govern` act. A principal is an issuer + oid the Host verifies from a token. A workload grant (actingAs agent:…) is usable only through a delegation token the Host issues to that workload, and never exceeds the grant it is delegatedBy.

rules.note: A HashRelay decision is approved by a person, never by whoever proposed or amended it.

body.reason: Stage 9: HashRelay's architectural decisions are governed from the Host-kept record
